notes: Building turrets to defend a base is base defense, which is Strategy; the endless zombie horde makes Survival an honest second genre but the activity the prompt describes is placement, not evasion. Base Defense fits rather than Tower Defense because no lane is described - the base is defended from every direction, so terrain-open is right and no hard-coded enemy track should be generated, which also keeps this off the P6 a lane would force. buildzone-plot is added on top of the preset because the one thing the prompt actually asks for is ground where friends place turrets, bent to a single shared base rather than one plot each; destructible-cluster was dropped since nothing along a route needs clearing. Decided without a user: the base is the health pool that the endless waves eventually bring down, so tracker-core is the run's end point, and the bright cartoonish treatment is dressing that changes no route.
